Data Centre Operations — Tasmania

Putting a decade of building data to work — intelligence from rack to plant room

A Tasmanian data centre operator had spent the better part of a decade sitting on a wealth of building data, right down to individual racks, with no easy way to make sense of it. Working alongside BAC, we gave the team a single place to ask plain-language questions and get answers they could act on — turning a system they rarely touched into one they now lean on every day.

A modern Tasmanian data centre — where building data finally meets everyday decisions.

Case Study
01

The Challenge

The information had always been there, held in a building management system the team interacted with but never fully understood. Plenty of value was going spare, and a few things stood out:

Data the team couldn't read

A decade of detail, down to the rack, locked behind a system that was hard to interpret.

Monitoring without the payoff

The operator was paying for visibility yet getting little back, because the data was never put to use.

No time to explore it

Like everyone, the team never found a spare moment to learn what the system could really tell them.

Gaps when faults hit

Diagnosing a plant or chiller problem called for expertise the team didn't always have on hand.

Hundreds of racks, two power streams, one cooling envelope — now legible at a glance.
Server Hall

Bitpool
Case Study
02

The Solution

BAC brought Bitpool in, starting with energy capture on the mechanical plant and growing from there. The real shift came the moment the team could simply ask the data questions in plain English. Together we delivered:

01

One place to ask, in plain language

A chat tool the team can question about any condition on site, with a clear answer back and no BMS know-how required.

02

Visibility down to the rack

Live readings across hundreds of racks at once: temperature, consumption and how each one compares to the rest.

03

Balancing the A and B power streams

Bitpool checks every rack in moments and flags any imbalance between the two streams, ready to pass to the client to even out.

04

Guided fault-finding

When a chiller played up, the team asked Bitpool for a likely cause and the steps to fix it, then forwarded the list straight to the contractor.

Plant room and server hall as one connected picture — the digital twin the operator now reads daily.

04

Strategic Value

  • A decade of building data turned from an unused cost into something the operator relies on daily.
  • Stronger budget cases, with efficiency gains that help justify investment in new chillers.
  • Plain-language access that closes the gap between the data and the people who must act on it.
  • BAC's automation know-how paired with Bitpool's data platform, with room to grow across more sites.
  • A measurable route to better PUE through more free cooling, in a climate that allows it most of the year.
